verdict.rationale: Luma documents a Draft Mode, and its pricing lists a cheaper 360p (Draft) tier at 20 credits for a 5s text-to-video or image-to-video clip, which covers fast, cheaper drafting. Nothing in the pack shows a way to upscale or re-render a chosen draft take to final quality, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented upscale/promote-draft-to-final workflow, the output resolutions and cost of the final-quality pass, any confirmation that the chosen take is preserved when upscaled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR pipeline
